description: Score how well AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) can find, read and cite a public web page: 0-100 score, letter grade, pass/fail checks (AI answer-bot access in robots.txt, server-rendered content, title/meta, JSON-LD, canonical, llms.txt, sitemap) and a prioritized fix list. Blocking bulk training crawlers is treated as a policy choice and does not lower the score.

url.description: Public page URL or domain, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com/pricing".

name: ai_visibility_score
title: AI visibility score
